executiveSummary.conclusion: Linear looks like a professional services business with a credible public presence — but several growth and operations signals remain disconnected.
executiveSummary.rationale: Based on the website at linear.app, the strongest near-term opportunity is capturing and qualifying inbound interest. Marketing performance and operational load cannot yet be confirmed without analytics, knowledge, and CRM connections.

confidence.reason: The website provides useful positioning context, but marketing and operational data are not yet connected.

recommendations.name: Sales Peer

businessBrainConclusion.statement: If I were your Chief of Staff, I would begin by deploying a Sales Peer to qualify inbound interest on linear.app — then connect analytics and knowledge so marketing and support recommendations move from likely to observed.

confidence.reason: The starting move is clear from website signals; confidence in sequencing would increase once CRM and analytics are connected.
